lines.text: If they take him for a fool, he asks to be received as one so he may boast a little.
He asks if others are Hebrews, Israelites, and descendants of Moses, and answers that he is too.
He received the forty lashes minus one five times, was beaten with rods three times, and was stoned once.
Paul was shipwrecked twice and spent a night and a day in the open sea.
The governor under King Aretas secured Damascus to arrest him, but he was lowered in a basket through a window.
